$comment: Copy the keys you need into .devbook/config.json. Every key is optional; an absent key takes the engine's documented default. `id` names the repository — lowercase, digits, hyphens — and is what a machine keys its own overlay for this repository on; pick it once and never rename it. `phases` holds one map per flow, keyed by the flow's skill name, and a committed map lists every phase its flow has: {} is a complete entry, running the phase's own skill on the session's model and effort. An entry may name the `agent` that runs the phase (plugin:agent, a bare plugin with one agent, repo:<agent>, or null for inline), the `skill` it follows (plugin:skill or repo:<skill>), its `model` and `effort` — team defaults a user overlay overrides — its `mcp` servers by the id your own MCP configuration declares, and `before` and `after` chores; phase-verify takes `app` and phase-report-back `targets`. The models below are the cost profile the engine shipped with; the agents start unset: fill each with whichever specialist you installed. A qualifier after a colon is the folder on phase-drafting and an area on phase-implement; `areas` is an optional hint of path globs per area. phase-personal-validation and phase-ready take no entry. A chore may carry --flag arguments after its id; the scope.after sample is a replan chore, which stops a run whose agreed plan the base has moved under. delivery.tracker takes github, jira, markdown, or backlog, or a plugin:skill that implements read_item, update_item, and comment. delivery.surface lists the surface servers a run uses — every listed one that opens records the run, and render and export take the first that answers; only a server named delivery-surface-* is a surface — and is usually set per machine in an overlay. A gate attaches to a phase id. mcp-template.json / mcp-vscode-template.json beside this file declare the default servers for .mcp.json and .vscode/mcp.json. Validate with tools/stack-config/check.mjs. The contract is resources/engine-contract.md. Never put a secret in this file.
